responsibility: Provides the LRA driver and shared utilities for GCC’s reload replacement. It coordinates the iterative sequence of constraint solving, elimination updates, inheritance/splitting, live-range recomputation, assignment, coalescing, rematerialization, spilling, final elimination, and final code cleanup; maintains the internal insn representation and scratch handling; and finalizes CFG/RTL state expected by later passes. This is the control-flow backbone of LRA rather than a single transformation algorithm.
same_name_distinction: This is the LRA implementation source and main driver, containing the iterative reload-replacement pipeline, shared utilities, and one-time init/fini code. The same-stem header gcc/lra.h is only the narrow external interface used to invoke LRA or query simple allocator properties.
